items.title: XElectron launches CineLux 4K projector in India with 4,000 ANSI lumens & 20W Dolby Audio speakers
items.summary: XElectron has launched the CineLux 4K, a new smart projector in India, expanding its home entertainment lineup. It is priced at ₹49,990 ($535) and offers native 4K resolution, built-in speakers, and an Android operating system. The projector is now available for purchase through
